decisions.title: Repository-native canonical state with rendered views
decisions.question: How should Project Foundry preserve objective, scope, progress, and resume state across sessions?
hard_constraints: The repository must become the source of truth.
The non-technical owner needs a simple Persian view.
The current task must not redefine the North Star.
decisions.rationale: It preserves repository-native truth, supports deterministic validation, and allows separate owner and agent renderings without requiring an external runtime.

decisions.title: Select MVP dogfooding implementation strategy
decisions.question: Which implementation strategy should Project Foundry use to observe its own development and extract validated future pipeline rules?
hard_constraints: No always-on background worker is required for MVP.
No external database is required for MVP.
The method must be operable by AI and understandable to a non-technical owner.
Observations must not silently promote themselves into authority.
Repository and PR evidence must remain usable.
